title: Machine learning selects a 12-gene tuberculosis signature; modules overlap Alzheimer's
summary: Whole-blood analysis found 1,389 dysregulated genes in 16 PTB-associated co-expression modules, and nested machine learning selected a 12-gene signature with AUC of about 0.99 in the discovery cohort that retained performance in two independent external PTB datasets without retraining. Most PTB immune modules showed concordant activity in an Alzheimer's disease dataset. This is a preprint using public retrospective data, the AD link is correlative, and machine learning is a secondary component.
ai_technology: Nested machine learning on whole-blood transcriptomes after weighted gene co-expression network analysis to select a 12-gene pulmonary tuberculosis signature

evidence.tested: 12-gene signature tested without retraining in two independent external PTB datasets.
evidence.unknown: Causal or clinical meaning of the PTB-AD link; preprint; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Nested machine learning for gene signature selection from blood transcriptomes
